operations.title: 1247 — Compatible Five-Cycle Denominator Bases Do Not Form a Triangulation Chain
operations.body: The 180 compatible four-facet supplements have 230 labelled three-facet ridges with multiplicities 35×2, 130×3, 65×4. Since all candidate determinant weights have equal magnitude, the 130 odd triple incidences cannot cancel under any orientation. The packet is a denominator-incidence census, not a canonical triangulation.

operations.title: Benincasa falsifies the naive 180-term five-cycle triangulation
operations.body: Entry 1247: the 180 compatible denominator bases are not a unit-weight simplicial chain. Their 230 labelled three-facet ridges have multiplicities 35×2, 130×3, 65×4; the 130 odd triple incidences cannot cancel under orientations, while Entry 1246 fixes equal absolute weights. Thus Entry 1199 is a candidate incidence packet, not a serialized OFPT triangulation. Landau-support closure survives; the period route must derive a genuine recursion/triangulation or the adjoint numerator.
